# Public capabilities and environment coverage

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-capabilities.mjs from scripts/lib/capabilities.mjs; do not edit by hand. -->

This registry describes implemented public workflows. Availability is not runtime readiness or a security verdict. `doctor` performs static installation checks; it does not execute target code, Docker, or network requests.

| Capability | Release support | Public commands | Behavior and limits |
|---|---|---|---|
| source-review | AVAILABLE | `plan`, `next`, `ingest`, `ingest-batch`, `finalize`, `validate` | Sealed repository inventory, scoped review packets, validated result ingestion, and coverage accounting. An external reviewer supplies analysis. Completion and zero findings do not establish security clearance. |
| review-integration | AVAILABLE | `review-template`, `check-result` | Export an inert result template and validate a reviewer result against its sealed packet without ingesting it. Integration helpers do not perform semantic source analysis or run an analysis provider. |
| source-analysis-provider | UNAVAILABLE | None | Bundled automated semantic source-analysis provider. The reference byte consumer checks transport behavior; it does not analyze security. |
| status | AVAILABLE | `status` | Read saved progress, coverage gaps, failures, and interrupted attempts. Saved state is not evidence that a target remains unchanged. |
| reports | AVAILABLE | `report`, `compare` | Generate Markdown and SARIF reports and compare finding lineages. Disappearance is claimed-fixed or not-observed, never independently verified remediation. |
| repair-brief | AVAILABLE | `repair-brief` | Prepare evidence-linked repair and retest guidance from recorded findings. A brief does not patch a target, execute a retest, or verify a fix. |
| verdict-assessment | AVAILABLE | `verdict` | Explain the evidence supporting and limiting a recorded verdict. Descriptive assessment cannot promote provider claims into controller-authenticated semantic proof. |
| benchmark | AVAILABLE | `benchmark` | Evaluate recorded benchmark submissions against labeled cases and report coverage and accuracy limitations. Fixture tests and evaluator scores do not establish independent real-world detection accuracy. |
| readiness | AVAILABLE | `doctor`, `capabilities` | Inspect local installation prerequisites and publish this capability registry without target execution. Static checks do not inspect a Docker daemon, verify an image, or prove runtime readiness. |
| t1-proof | AVAILABLE_NARROW | `run-proof` | Sealed, network-denied repository proof through the fixed Docker worker route. Requires a compatible immutable Node/npm worker, sealed inputs, and the existing proof contract; no arbitrary runtime support. |
| t2-service-proof | AVAILABLE_NARROW | `run-service-proof` | One foreground Node/npm service with loopback probes in separate isolated sessions and verified cleanup. Lifecycle evidence remains UNPROVEN without a controller-authenticated semantic oracle. Browser and multi-service/database stacks are unsupported. |
| https-recon | AVAILABLE_NARROW | `http-recon go` | One bounded HTTPS reconnaissance action through its existing public controller. A URL entry point is not a comprehensive website assessment. |
| authenticated-http | AVAILABLE_NARROW | `http-authed campaign-attested`, `http-authed campaign-stop` | Fixed sealed authenticated HTTP requests through the existing campaign controller. No generic live probing or automatic scope expansion is provided. |
| semantic-oracle | UNAVAILABLE | None | Controller-authenticated semantic vulnerability and remediation verdicts. Process exit differences and cleanup receipts alone cannot establish a vulnerability or a verified fix. |
| browser-execution | UNAVAILABLE | None | Browser-driven application testing. Browser configuration can be reviewed as source; a public browser execution route is not shipped. |
| database-stack-execution | UNAVAILABLE | None | Database-backed and multi-service application execution. Retained conformance kernels are not public target execution capabilities. |
| multi-runtime-execution | UNAVAILABLE | None | Python, JVM, .NET, Go, Rust, and native target execution. A language detected in source does not imply a compatible public proof worker. |
| deployed-evidence-acquisition | UNAVAILABLE | None | Acquire and trust current deployment or cloud runtime evidence. Repository deployment configuration does not establish what is running. Public evidence-import and acquisition transports remain unavailable. |
| generic-live | UNAVAILABLE | None | Generic autonomous live assessment, bounty, and out-of-band workflows. Only the specific implemented public routes listed above are available. |
| remote-provider-and-publication | UNAVAILABLE | None | Public provider execution, remote gateways, and transparency publication. Retained command names fail closed pending their required trusted runtime identities. |

## Environment declarations

Recorded filename indicators can identify likely review and execution gaps. They neither open current target files nor establish what is deployed. A source-review profile does not promise language-specific analysis completeness.

| Profile | Source review workflow | Public execution | Limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| node-npm | AVAILABLE | AVAILABLE_NARROW | Compatible sealed Node/npm T1 and single-service loopback T2 only; dependencies and worker image must match. |
| python | AVAILABLE | UNAVAILABLE | Source review is available; no public Python proof execution profile. |
| dotnet | AVAILABLE | UNAVAILABLE | Source review is available; no public .NET proof execution profile. |
| jvm | AVAILABLE | UNAVAILABLE | Source review is available; no public JVM proof execution profile. |
| go | AVAILABLE | UNAVAILABLE | Source review is available; no public Go proof execution profile. |
| rust-native | AVAILABLE | UNAVAILABLE | Source review is available; no public Rust or native proof execution profile. |
| browser | AVAILABLE | UNAVAILABLE | Browser source and test configuration do not establish browser execution coverage. |
| database-stack | AVAILABLE | UNAVAILABLE | Database or composition indicators require source review; multi-service execution is unavailable. |
| deployment-configuration | AVAILABLE | UNAVAILABLE | Configuration can be reviewed but does not establish deployed state or active acquisition support. |
